## M1 Registration submitted

**Due:** 2026-12-01 (fictional-formal)

**Justification:** Registration starts the six-month writing period (SP-DH-2025 Art. 15 Abs. 4). The real registration dates are in the official documents of the Dean's Office (RSL Phil.-hist. 21 Art. 55 Abs. 2). The workshop uses a fictional date.

## M2 Data documented and validated

**Due:** 2027-03-01 (proposed)

**Justification:** The analysis needs a validated dataset. Three months before submission leave time for analysis (about six weeks) and for writing and feedback (about six weeks).

## M3 Thesis submitted

**Due:** 2027-06-01 (fictional-formal)

**Justification:** Fictional registration date 2026-12-01 plus the six-month writing period (SP-DH-2025 Art. 15 Abs. 4). A late submission is graded 1 (RSL Phil.-hist. 21 Art. 56 Abs. 4). Only the supervisor can extend the period, once, by one semester, for a serious reason (Art. 56 Abs. 2).
